name: Question 6
problem:
Consider the augmented matrix $X,$ given by

$$
X=[\begin{aligned}1 & 3 & 2 & 1 \\ 1 & 5 & -1 & 2 \\ 3 & 4 & -2 & 3\end{aligned}].
$$

What matrix results from carrying out the row operation ${R}_{2}:={R}_{2}+(-1)\cdot {R}_{1}$ on $X?$
